work_completed: Created src/simulation/environment/schedule.py implementing the DailySchedule system for autonomous Sims routines: NeedType/FurnitureType enums, FurnitureComponent/RoomComponent/NeedsComponent supporting ECS components, ScheduleEntry dataclass (with wrap-around-midnight coverage), DailySchedule, get_workday_schedule()/get_weekend_schedule() factories, ScheduleComponent, IdleBehavior fallback, and ScheduleSystem.

Wired ScheduleSystem into WorldEngine._register_core_systems (lazily imported to avoid circular imports) so it runs each tick; added four EventType members (SCHEDULE_ACTIVITY_CHANGED, SCHEDULE_MOVE_QUEUED, NEED_FULFILLED, IDLE_BEHAVIOR_TRIGGERED); added the schedule module to component deserialization (_try_import_component).
Exported all new symbols from src/simulation/environment/__init__.py.

Added tests/test_simulation/test_schedule.py (49 test cases) covering enums, entry coverage/validation/round-trip, DailySchedule, default schedules, support components, ScheduleComponent, IdleBehavior, ScheduleSystem behavior, and WorldEngine save/load + tick integration.
decisions_made: Defined NeedType and FurnitureType as str-enums in schedule.py (no separate needs.py/rooms.py module exists yet); this keeps the schedule system self-contained per the bead scope.

Added lightweight FurnitureComponent, RoomComponent and NeedsComponent in schedule.py so the acceptance criteria (find bed in bedroom, fulfill need) are concrete and save/load-serializable rather than event-only.
Schedule iteration uses first-match priority, matching the Sims scheduling model; default factory schedules order meals before work to avoid overlaps.
Weekend status derived from TimeManager.day via is_weekend() (day 1=Mon); the system auto-syncs ScheduleComponent.weekend each tick.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: The next open bead (FastAPI world-state router in backend/app/routers/world.py) can consume EventType.SCHEDULE_ACTIVITY_CHANGED / NEED_FULFILLED / SCHEDULE_MOVE_QUEUED / IDLE_BEHAVIOR_TRIGGERED and the ScheduleComponent/NeedsComponent/FurnitureComponent/RoomComponent to expose Sim activities, need levels and locations in GET /world/state and GET /world/sims/{sim_id}. pytest/flake8/mypy are not installed in this container; validation was performed via an equivalent standalone harness (all checks green).
tests_run: New tests/test_simulation/test_schedule.py executed via an equivalent harness: 49/49 cases pass (factory schedules, coverage/validation/round-trip, DailySchedule priority, support components, ScheduleComponent, IdleBehavior, ScheduleSystem move/fulfill/idle/busy-preservation, WorldEngine save/load + tick).
Regression smoke on existing WorldEngine + RelationshipSystem behaviour (co-located sims tick, relationship save/load, Position save/load): no regressions.
